name: Hoopla Impro
what_it_is: UK's biggest improv school (London) with online and in-person courses from beginner to performance level.
notes: Listed in seeds; course-level descriptions public.

name: Gotham Writers Workshop (broader storytelling/humor catalog)
what_it_is: Writing school with online courses in storytelling, humor writing, memoir.
notes: Humor Writing course separate from stand-up.

name: Heroic Public Speaking (Michael & Amy Port)
what_it_is: Performance-based speaker training school (from 'Steal the Show' author) with GRAD program and HQ campus; rehearsal-centric pedagogy.
notes: Acting-derived rehearsal techniques; mostly pro speakers.

name: Moxie Institute
what_it_is: Corporate public speaking/presentation training using neuroscience + performing-arts methods; also self-paced masterclasses.

name: Dale Carnegie Course
what_it_is: Century-old human-relations and public-speaking training (live + online) descended from 'How to Win Friends and Influence People'; highly practice-driven sessions.
notes: Principles public via books; session structure = repeated low-stakes talks.

name: American Comedy Institute (Stephen Rosenfield)
what_it_is: NYC stand-up school by 'Mastering Stand-Up' author; classes online and in person.
